audit.why: The packet levelChart is Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir and matches every whys[] line. Three stored rows disagree with their own explanation text.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 4 become Skill; row 5 becomes Vladimir. Rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 are already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and Unstoppable Onslaught is treated as a single fixed threat.
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10s at rank 1 falling to 6s; Soul Furnace is 15s to 11s and re-arms 3 seconds after the shield; Roar of the Slayer is 12s to 8s at 800 range; Unstoppable Onslaught drops from 140s at rank 1 to 60s at rank 3 — it more than doubles in frequency, which is the real late-game spike and the page never says so.
audit.corrected: R is 140s at rank 1 but 60s at rank 3; Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 and 16s at rank 5, so the pool covers his ult only once it is maxed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Roar of the Slayer (E) is never mentioned in any field despite being his lane poke. Decimating Smash is described as 'Charged = knockup' without stating that a partially charged Q has no CC at all. spikes[2] tells the player to 'deny his shield value by not feeding it free stacks' — Soul Furnace gains max Health when Sion KILLS units, not from damage you take.
audit.why: The E is his highest-uptime damage and it knocks a minion backwards through your position, so it hits twice; the charge threshold is what makes the Q dodgeable; and the shield-stacking line tells the player to change a behaviour that does nothing.
audit.corrected: Only a fully charged Decimating Smash knocks up and stuns — a tapped Q is damage only. Roar of the Slayer knocks a struck minion back through you for a second hit, so do not stand in line behind your own wave. His max-Health stacks come from last-hitting, so contest CS rather than withholding damage. Glory in Death heals him on every attack after he dies, so anti-heal matters into the reanimation, and Unstoppable Onslaught's terrain can cut your retreat when you have no dash.
